item.title: Bitwise Solana ETF Crosses $1 Billion
item.description:
Bitwise Solana ETF Crosses $1 Billion

A regulated wrapper for a once-exotic chain just crossed a line that, until recently, belonged only to Bitcoin and a handful of other crypto funds. Bitwise’s Solana Staking ETF, ticker BSOL, crossed $1 billion in assets under management on Aug. 28, 2026, about 10 months after it listed on Oct. 28, 2025 — the first standalone Solana ETF to hit that mark. The milestone is a flow story, a staking story, and a concentration story at once. It is also a price story that refuses to cooperate: SOL itself is about 60 percent below its all-time high, which means the billion dollars arrived while the underlying token was still living in a drawdown.
